facts.business: Nirlon Limited is engaged in the licensing of investment properties, primarily commercial real estate leasing in India.
key_risks: Related party transactions involving significant amounts for property and lease management services and marketing fees with Nirlon Management Services Private Limited, requiring judgement in determining transaction price
facts.related_party_note: The Company paid INR 1,772.24 lakhs for property and lease management services and INR 1,056.93 lakhs for marketing fees to Nirlon Management Services Private Limited, a related party. Dividend of INR 14,977.63 lakhs paid to holding company Reco Berry Private Limited, Singapore and INR 240.03 lakhs to Deltron Pte. Limited, Singapore. Remuneration paid to KMPs including CEO Rahul V. Sagar (INR 296.00 lakhs) and CS Jasmin K. Bhavsar (INR 145.83 lakhs).
